title: Lunch Counter

start.note: A note at the Corwin desk: 'Lunch counter. 12:30. Bring an appetite. R.C.'

objectives.text: The woman from the parked car
Follow her to her car, Fifth Ave
Two of Wurtz's men jump Calloway
objectives.note: Plainclothes cops: non-lethal only (killing police is a story-breaking crime)

objectives.text: Ask her what she wants with him

fail.note: Retry from the last checkpoint; hospital/arrest flow per Gameplay (CORE_SYSTEMS).

mobile: **Branch A** is an untimed two-option choice with a confirm step ('Are you sure?'), because it persists. Delphine's tail goes down Broadway and Sixth through lunch crowds, so it's generous.
design: **Branch A.** Calloway offers the wire. Choices in dlg.m12_calloway set flag.branch_a_wire or flag.branch_a_burned and the N3 §3 relationship changes. Delphine, two stools down because she followed her fifty dollars, learns who Calloway is, which gives her leverage in P4. COMBAT (26 Nov): see COMBAT table in build_act23_missions.py.
